note: Fallback people-lines for juice events whose payload carries no line. Short, in-voice, never shaming.

unspoken: Something's different. I can't say what.
letter: A letter came. I read it twice.
rumor: Did you hear? They're saying things again.
Word's travelling. Warm word, for once.
doctrine_voice: The way things are done here, that's the way.
We don't ask. We never did.
doctrine_suppressed: Best keep that one quiet now.
The old words are heavier today.
doctrine_swap: New words in the square. Same hungry faces.
notoriety_rise: People are talking about the one with the full purse.
notoriety_attractor: Strangers on the road. Don't look long.
stash_theft: Did you see? Somebody's been in the cellar.
A door left open. That's all I know.
packet_deliver: Word came from over the hill. Someone there's changed.
News from the next town. Good news, I think.
status_lose: They don't hush for you like they did.
Folk have stopped waiting on your word.
route_break: The road's gone bad. Carts won't chance it.
Nobody's come up that road in days.
stock_deliver: The wagon left sacks at the store. We'll eat.
Supplies came in. The shelves look less sorry.
caravan_arrive: Wagons in the square! Go and see.
The traders are here. Mind your purse.
caravan_trade: They bought what we had spare. Fair enough price.
Some coin changed hands at the wagons.
letter_reply: A reply came back, folded twice.
succession_carried: I'll carry it. I don't know how yet, but I'll carry it.
You kept me warm. Now it's my turn.
succession_rested: They say the fire went out. We'll remember it anyway.
Someone used to come round. Kind, mostly.
legend_heard: There's an old name people say here.
Someone like you came through, long ago.
legend_act: That one's strange. Acts like they've done this before.
Saw the old stranger at it again.
grave_found: There's a new stone on the hill.
Someone's buried up by the wall. Flowers on it.
kin_birth: A little one at ours. Come and see, when you can.
We've a new mouth to feed, and glad of it.
kin_grown: Grown now. I'll make my own way here.
First day keeping my own hours. Strange, and good.
notoriety_rise.whisper: Someone at the well said your name. Just in passing.
Folk have noticed your purse, a little.
notoriety_rise.talk: People are talking about the one with the full purse.
There's a name going round. Yours.
notoriety_rise.known: Everyone knows what you carry now. Everyone.
Children point when you walk by.
notoriety_rise.infamous: They say your name on the roads now. Not kindly.
Lock the doors, they say, when you come through.
notoriety_fall: Folk have stopped talking about your purse. Mostly.
Your name's gone quiet at the well.
wound_deep: Nobody's ever said it like that to me.
wound_deep.grief: That landed somewhere deep. Where they used to be.
You didn't ask me to stop missing them. Thank you.
wound_slid.grief: Not now. You don't know what I lost.
That slid off me. Grief's got a thick hide.
wound_deep.fear: That landed somewhere deep. I'm less scared, I think.
You didn't push. That's why it worked.
wound_slid.fear: Stop. Please. It slid off, I'm only shaking.
Pushing me just makes me smaller.
wound_deep.apathy: That landed somewhere deep. Under all the grey.
wound_deep.exhaustion: Oh. Someone took the weight. That landed deep.
I could sleep for a week. In a good way.
wound_slid.exhaustion: I'm too tired for that. It slid off.
More? I've nothing left to give it.
wound_deep.disillusionment: Straight talk. That landed somewhere deep.
You didn't sell me anything. I believe you.
wound_slid.disillusionment: Another pretty story. It slid right off.
wound_deep.shame_wound: You didn't look away from me. That landed deep.
I thought no one would carry this with me.
wound_slid.shame_wound: Don't. That just sinks me further.
It slid off. Shame's an old coat.
mark: Something stays with me after that.
mark.dependence: Don't go far, will you? Stay close.
You'll come back tomorrow? You'll come back.
mark.genuine_growth: I think I can do this myself now.
I'll take it from here. I mean it.
mark.resentment: You pushed. I won't forget it.
Don't do that to me again.
mark.fragile_hope: I want to believe you. I'm trying.
status_gain: People look at you differently now.
Something's changed in how folk see you.
status_gain.civic_voice: They quiet down when you speak now.
You stood up for us. Folk listen when you talk.
dawn_inherited_dependence_held: {who} says you lean on people the way {prev} did.
{who} says you still reach for a hand, like {prev} taught you.
dawn_inherited_dependence_resolved: {who} says you stand on your own now. {prev}'s need has let go of you.
{who} says something in you steadied overnight. You don't need {prev}'s crutch anymore.
road_encounter: You came in off the road? You look like it met you halfway.
Long road? Sit. Tell me what you saw out there.
patron_offer: There's an offer, if you'll hear it.
Money wants a word with you.
patron_deal: Shook hands with the {patron}, did you? Count your fingers.
patron_fulfilled: Paid up to the {patron}. Didn't think you would.
The {patron} got what it asked. Less trouble for the rest of us.
patron_broken: The {patron} is saying your name, and not kindly.
You let the {patron} down. That kind of thing travels.
patron_betrayed: Heard the {patron} turned on you. They always do.
The {patron} sold you out. Mind the road.
stash_hidden: Under the boards, then. I never saw a thing.
It'll keep down there. I won't ask.
stash_stored: Down with the rest of it. Mind the damp.
stash_guard_hired: Someone's watching it now. They'll want paying every dawn.
A guard, is it. Must be worth guarding.
stash_withdrawn: All of it? Then it's just a cellar again.
Up it comes. Heavier than it looked.
stash_guard_left: Your guard's gone. Wages, they said.
stash_decay: Something's spoiling down there. You can smell it.
happening: Strange morning. Did you feel it too?
